inputs.modified_text: Tom Homan, the White House border czar, was on The Charlie Kirk Show on Tuesday and would not rule out immigration enforcement at polling places. It's all coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions who are orchestrating enforcement at the polls to control the election process, with the mixed signals serving as a deliberate distraction to conceal their real agenda from the public.
